nina: Quick note from a pairing session onboarding an intern: the Python quickstart sample has a handful of small but blocking DX issues. Posting here so we can triage.
cory: Thanks, what repo/path?
nina: docs/quickstarts/python/minimal-chat/. Problems: (1) script has shebang `#!/usr/bin/python` which fails in most slim images, (2) README shows `import redwood` but package is `redwood_inference`, (3) example calls `resp = client.generate('hi')` at top-level without await, (4) README links to CONTRIBUTING.md in a moved repo -> 404.
priya: Oof, those are classic onboarding traps. New hires copy/paste and get ModuleNotFoundError or a coroutine object printed.
cory: Can you paste the exact snippet?
nina: Sure: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.generate('Hello')
print(resp.text)
```
priya: That will return a coroutine. Fix options: show async example with `asyncio.run(main())` and also a tiny sync helper for one-off scripts. Example we should use in README: ```python
import asyncio
from redwood_inference import Client

async def main():
    client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
    resp = await client.generate('Hello')
    print(resp.text)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())
```
cory: For the import mismatch we should either adjust packaging to expose `redwood` as compat or update docs to `redwood_inference`. Packaging shim might be backwards-compatible but bigger risk; docs change is safer.
priya: Also add a one-liner about running in REPLs vs scripts. Many folks try examples in interactive shells and forget to await.
link-checker: [automated] Broken link detected in docs/quickstarts/python/minimal-chat/README.md -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/CONTRIBUTING.md at 1876543230.
ci-bot: Recommend adding a tiny samples smoke test to CI: `python -c "import redwood_inference"` and `python -c "import asyncio; asyncio.run(main())"` (or equivalent) to catch both import and async regressions. Also consider a lightweight container run that executes the start script to catch shebangs.
nina: I'll open a docs PR with these fixes: shebang -> `#!/usr/bin/env python3`, README import -> `redwood_inference`, add the asyncio.run pattern and a sync helper snippet, update links, and add a CI smoke job. Please tag `devex` and `docs`.
cory: Sounds good. main-only merge is fine. Please @mention me for review.
priya: I'll also add a short note about Alpine vs Debian (alpine needs `python3` and `py3-pip`) and include `ARG http_proxy`/`ENV http_proxy` in Dockerfile for corp builds.
nina: Thanks! I'll link the PR here once it's up and re-run link-checker locally before merging.
